stepDesc.if: Run one branch or the other depending on a condition.
stepDesc.switch: Pick a branch by value; anything else goes to Default.
stepDesc.for: Repeat the body for every item of a list.
stepDesc.set: Compute a value and save it under a name for later layers.
stepDesc.return: End the method and send back a variable or a function result.
stepDesc.select: Read rows from a table. One row with limit 1, a list otherwise.
stepDesc.execute: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE. Returns the affected row count.
stepDesc.http: Call an external HTTP API and save the response.
stepDesc.produce: Put a message on a queue for background work.
stepDesc.consume: Take the next message from a queue.
